sources.title: Arrow 2 — exact model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact arrow-2 card confirms generally available hosted model, text/image/SVG input, SVG output, 131072-token context and 65536-token maximum output. Lists generation, vectorization, editing and animation subject to key capability, and Responses when open_responses is enabled. No size or neural topology is given. Raw Markdown was also read. Reopened October 27 for the parameter re-audit: the exact model-details table still contains only identity, modalities, context/output limits and billing, with neither total nor active parameters.

sources.title: Arrow model comparison table
sources.evidence: Current comparison table gives an exact Arrow 2 column: 131072 context, 65536 maximum output, text/image/SVG input and SVG output. Separately gives Telos 1050000 context. Both are generally available, with operation/key restrictions. Does not report parameter counts or topology. Reopened October 27: no total/activated-parameter columns or named counted base checkpoint appear in the current comparison.

sources.title: Introducing Arrow 2 and Arrow 2 Telos
sources.evidence: Visible date and JSON-LD datePublished both say September 7, 2026. The article introduces Arrow 2 and explicitly says it is available now for all users in the App. Describes vectorization, generation and SVG animation as code-based outputs. Does not disclose architecture, counts or training recipe; its frontier-model refinement wording specifically concerns Telos. Reopened October 27: no total/active count or named external base model is disclosed; the frontier-model wording remains specific to Telos.

sources.title: App and API Platform changelog
sources.evidence: September 16 entries announce the conversational App/canvas with Arrow 2, and Arrow 2/Open Responses/token billing in the API. Later September/October entries concern retirement, headers and data-control policy, not a model parameter disclosure. This is a later dated public introduction than the September 7 blog, without an explicit explanation of preview versus general availability. Reopened October 27 for newer disclosures: the latest October 6 entry concerns data controls, with no parameter count or counted base lineage.

sources.title: Official Arrow 2 introduction on X
sources.evidence: Original business-account post recovered through X official syndication JSON, created_at 2026-09-16T18:45:56.000Z. Introduces Arrow 2 and states availability in App and API. Direct X page returned 403; the original text and timestamp were read from cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=2100295136261349802&lang=en&token=0. sources.title: Migrate to the Responses API
sources.evidence: Exact arrow-2 examples declare function tools, return function_call items for caller execution, and replay results and opaque reasoning IDs. Supports model-chosen tool selection with tool_choice auto and custom tools. Current guide explicitly says hosted tools, including old quiver tools, are not supported. Native SVG responses return data[].svg source strings; Responses returns calls and assistant message items.

sources.title: Text to SVG
sources.evidence: Exact arrow-2 examples accept prompt text and reference images and stream reasoning, draft and content phases. Documents up to 14 references and 65536 maximum output tokens. Its string SVG results and phases establish textual vector-code output and reasoning support; no raster image synthesis or video output is claimed.

sources.title: Terms of Service — sections 5 and 6
sources.evidence: The actual terms grant limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable, revocable service access, restrict reproduction/modification/distribution of the service, and reserve rights to QuiverAI and licensors. Supports Proprietary classification for this hosted model; user-output rights and open SDK licenses do not distribute model weights.

sources.title: Arrow models
sources.evidence: Names the Arrow family, with separate Arrow 2 and Arrow 2 Telos entries. Explicitly describes every Arrow model as writing editable SVG rather than pixels. No numerical parameter or neural architecture table.

sources.evidence: First-party training description says QuiverAI trains its own models to generate SVG/visual code using a language-model approach. Reopened October 27: StarVector and RLRF are identified as the founders' prior research, not as Arrow 2 base checkpoints. No numerical size or explicit Arrow 2 lineage can be inherited from that statement.

sources.title: TIDES: Test-time Inference Drift Exploitation via Scaling — author project and extended results

Reopened October 27, including the original authors' Table 1 model/backbone rows and methodology: none identifies Arrow 2 or an Arrow base relationship.

name.note: Exact display name and arrow-2 identifier; arrow-2.0 is explicitly not the API identifier.

developer.note: Named developer and service operator in exact model documentation and official announcement.

family.note: Normalize to the explicitly documented Arrow model family.

release_date.note: September public availability is verified; earliest day remains unresolved. Blog visible and structured date September 7 says available now for all users, while the September 16 original business-account post introduces Arrow 2 as available in App/API and the same-day changelog launches updated App/API features. Do not invent a preview-versus-GA distinction or assume the later platform rollout proves the first model release.

open_weights.note: Released as a hosted App/API model under restricted service terms. Reviewed official repositories expose integration code rather than Arrow 2 weights; open SDK/plugin code does not make this model open weights.

license.note: Descriptive service/model classification from limited-access and retained-rights provisions; no open-weight license was recovered.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no total count or explicit relationship to a counted base for exact Arrow 2. Current model pages, release/archive/changelog and public repositories supply no size; StarVector/RLRF are prior research, while TIDES, VectorGym and OASIS identify different experimental checkpoints. No nominal count is inferred from speed, price or shared authorship.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh searches for exact Arrow 2 active/activated counts and original research comparison tables found no applicable convention. The current author-linked tables concern other named models. No active count is inferred from total size, attention routing, latency, pricing or Telos refinement wording.

architecture.note: Visual code/token generation does not by itself establish Transformer topology or dense/MoE structure. No exact Arrow 2 neural architecture was disclosed in reviewed first-party specifications or research; the older Arrow 1.0 language-model framing and unrelated TIDES backbones are not transferred.

context_window.note: Exact published model context limit, distinct from maximum output 65536 and Telos 1050000. No claim of native unscaled training length.

modalities.note: Input supports text, raster reference images and SVG source. Output is editable SVG source code or textual assistant/tool-call content; normalize that code to text. Remove image output inferred merely from image/svg+xml MIME or a rendered/exported preview. SVG animation emits animated vector code, not native video.

reasoning.note: Exact Arrow 2 native generation streams reasoning phases; Responses history includes opaque reasoning items and billing accounts for reasoning tokens. This establishes supported reasoning, not a claim that every endpoint exposes private reasoning text or every effort setting.

tool_call.note: Caller-declared function/custom tools and returned calls are documented with exact arrow-2 examples, including automatic selection. The caller executes tools; current Responses guide explicitly excludes hosted tools, despite older site wording.

description.value: QuiverAI model that generates, edits, vectorizes and animates SVG code from text and image inputs.
description.note: Uses documented capabilities and code output without unsupported comparative speed or image-generation claims; operations remain subject to endpoint/key availability.

patch.description: QuiverAI model that generates, edits, vectorizes and animates SVG code from text and image inputs.

sources.label: TIDES: Test-time Inference Drift Exploitation via Scaling — author project and extended results

patch.notes: Release month is September 2026: the official blog dated September 7 states App availability, while the official September 16 X introduction and changelog describe App/API availability and platform changes. The earliest day is unresolved. Context is 131,072 tokens, with a separate 65,536-token output cap. The model generates SVG source code, including animation, rather than raster images or video; exported previews do not add native output modalities. Responses supports caller-executed function/custom tools when enabled for the key. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed; no counted base lineage is documented for Arrow 2. Neural topology is also undisclosed. Sizes from the contributors' separate research models do not establish Arrow 2's size.

summary: Parameter re-audit completed October 27: total and active counts remain undisclosed after reopening exact model documentation, product/release pages, archive/changelog, public repositories and TIDES, plus fresh total/active/base-lineage searches and the original VectorGym/OASIS comparison tables. No counted Arrow 2 base relationship or applicable active-count convention was found. Explicit null patches now cover both counts and parameters_source. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
